nodes.name: cobalt carbonate hydroxide supported on NF
Co-Pre Hydrothermal Synthesis
nodes.procedure: The Nickel foam was pre-washed with HCl (3 M), EtOH and acetone solutions to remove the nickel oxide and hydrocarbons on the surface. The cleaned nickel foam was immersed in DI water (35 mL) containing Co(NO3)2·6H2O (1.455g, 5 mmol), NH4F (0.111g, 3 mmol) and urea (0.541g, 9 mmol) in a Teflon-lined stainless autoclave (50 mL). The autoclave was sealed and maintained at 95°C for 10 h in an oven, then cooled down to room temperature. The obtained cobalt carbonate hydroxide supported on NF (Co-pre) was repeatedly washed with ethanol and DI water and then dried in an oven at 60°C.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of Co-Pre: The Nickel foam was pre-washed with HCl (3 M)... dried in an oven at 60°C.

nodes.name: MoCo-Pre Secondary Hydrothermal
nodes.procedure: The obtained Co-pre samples were immersed in DI water (35mL) each dissolved in Na2MoO4·2H2O (100mg), and were placed in the PTFE liner (50mL). The reactor was sealed and kept in an oven at 130°C for 6 h, and then cooled to room temperature. The MoCo-pre supported by NF was obtained. It was washed repeatedly with ethanol and DI water and then dried in an oven at 60°C.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of MoCo-Pre: The obtained Co-pre samples were immersed in DI water (35mL)... dried in an oven at 60°C.

nodes.name: CoPx Phosphorization
nodes.procedure: The obtained Co-pre and NaH2PO2·H2O (600 mg) were put in the same porcelain boat and Co-pre was suspended to avoid direct contact with NaH2PO2·H2O. Subsequently, the whole porcelain boat was put in a tube furnace. The furnace was slowly heated to 100°C in 60 min and then ramped to 350°C in 30 min at the N2 atmosphere and maintained for 2.5 h, where the NaH2PO2 was thermally decomposed to PH3. Finally, it naturally cooled to ambient temperature. The obtained CoPx hybrid supported on NF (CoPx@NF) was repeatedly washed with ethanol and DI water and then dried in an oven at 60°C, which was also named CoPx.
